info.name: Qodo Platform (Modeled Capability Surfaces) Qodo Command API
Run a Qodo Command agent over HTTP (modeled - CLI --webhook)

params.name: agent
params.description: Name of the configured agent (from agents.toml).

items.docs: Models the local HTTP surface the Qodo Command CLI exposes when an agent defined in agents.toml is launched with `--webhook`. The agent runs and returns its result. Self-hosted; not a Qodo-hosted endpoint.
